title: Systemic risk in interbank networks: disentangling balance sheets and network effects
abstract: arXiv:2109.14360v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study how the level of systemic risk empirically observed in an interbank network differs from the expected risk implied by the balance sheets composition of the participating banks, abstracting from the specific configuration of bilateral exposures. To this end, using different contagion models (i.e., interbank asset valuation functions), we measure observed systemic risk on e-MID network data from 2005 to 2012 and compare it with the expected risk generated by a null model: an ensemble of interbank networks whose links represent possible market clearing configurations. This counterfactual is obtained through a maximum-entropy approach that preserves banks' balance sheet variables and diversification patterns, while randomizing the configuration of exposures. translated_title: 银行间网络中的系统性风险：解析资产负债表与网络效应
translated_abstract: 我们研究银行间网络中实证观察到的系统性风险水平，与仅由参与银行资产负债表构成所隐含的预期风险之间的差异，而不考虑双边敞口的具体配置。为此，我们使用不同的传染模型（即银行间资产估值函数），基于2005年至2012年的e-MID网络数据测量观察到的系统性风险，并将其与零模型产生的预期风险进行比较。该零模型是一个银行间网络的集合，其链接代表可能的市场出清配置。这一反事实是通过最大熵方法构建的，该方法在保留银行资产负债表变量和多样化模式的同时，随机化敞口的配置。我们发现，观察到的与预期的系统性风险在总体水平上通常是一致的，但在动荡时期会出现显著分歧——具体是在（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文的核心贡献在于通过基于最大熵的零模型，将银行间网络中的系统性风险分解为资产负债表构成效应与网络结构效应，发现两者总体一致但在金融危机等动荡时期显著背离。
en_tdlr: This paper's key contribution is disentangling balance sheet effects from network structure effects in interbank systemic risk using a maximum-entropy null model, finding that they are generally consistent but diverge significantly during turbulent periods such as financial crises.
